summary: Bug fix verification complete - Ticket click modal now works correctly for both multi-play and simple tickets without crashing. The critical bug 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading map)' has been fixed. All requested features tested and working.

tickets.tsx lines 264-336: renderTicket correctly distinguishes between multi-play tickets (ticket_type='multi_play') and simple tickets
detailed-seller-report.tsx lines 773-1001: Period filters (Diario, Semanal, Quincenal, Mensual) work correctly
Header icons (share, PDF, refresh) are visible and positioned correctly in detailed-seller-report
seed_data_creation: No seed data created - used existing tickets in database
